# NMS Optimizer

> Free, open-source technology layout optimizer for No Man's Sky that calculates mathematically optimal technology module placements to maximize adjacency bonuses and supercharged slot multipliers.

NMS Optimizer (https://nms-optimizer.app) is an endgame optimization tool designed to solve complex inventory grid layouts for players of *No Man's Sky*. The solver uses a hybrid optimization pipeline—combining community-proven placement heuristics, a TensorFlow machine learning model trained on 16,000+ top layouts, and a Rust-powered simulated annealing engine—to evaluate combinatorial configurations (up to ~8.32 × 10⁸¹ permutations) in milliseconds. Optimized layouts routinely achieve 15–20% higher effective performance than manual arrangements.

## Key Game Concepts

- **Adjacency Bonuses**: Compatible technology modules placed adjacent to each other on the grid receive compounding stat multipliers based on shared edges.
- **Supercharged Slots**: Limited high-potency grid slots (~25–30% stat boost). The optimizer balances placing core technology versus top-tier upgrade modules in these slots.
- **Upgrade Tiers (Theta / Tau / Sigma)**: Procedural upgrades are ranked strictly by evaluated stats rather than class letters (X-Class can beat S-Class):
  - **Theta**: Highest-rolled stats
  - **Tau**: Mid-tier stats
  - **Sigma**: Lowest-rolled stats
- **Supported Platforms**: Starships (Standard, Sentinel Interceptor, Solar, Living, Exotic), Multi-Tools (including Staves), Freighters, Corvettes (Cosmetic and Reactor tech sets), Exosuits, and Exocraft.
- **Interoperability**: Layouts can be exported and imported as `.nms` JSON files, shared via URL hashes, or rendered to image cards.

## Documentation & Guides

All public routes support HTTP content negotiation via `Accept: text/markdown` as well as direct `index.md` Agent Markdown Document URLs across all 6 supported locales: English (`en` at `/`), Spanish (`es` at `/es/`), French (`fr` at `/fr/`), German (`de` at `/de/`), Portuguese (`pt` at `/pt/`), and Italian (`it` at `/it/`).

- [Homepage & Optimizer Overview](https://nms-optimizer.app/index.md): Overview of the No Man's Sky technology layout builder, supported equipment platforms, and optimization workflow (`https://nms-optimizer.app/`).
- [User Instructions & Strategy Guide](https://nms-optimizer.app/instructions/index.md): Comprehensive gameplay guide covering grid setup, supercharged slot allocation strategy, row toggles, and platform constraints (`https://nms-optimizer.app/instructions/`).
- [About & Engine Architecture](https://nms-optimizer.app/about/index.md): In-depth documentation on the four-step solver pipeline, permutation scale, supported equipment, and tech stack (`https://nms-optimizer.app/about/`).
- [Changelog & Update History](https://nms-optimizer.app/changelog/index.md): Release notes, game update compatibility (e.g. Worlds Part I & II), new technology modules, and performance optimizations (`https://nms-optimizer.app/changelog/`).
- [User Statistics & Community Meta](https://nms-optimizer.app/userstats/index.md): Aggregate optimization statistics, supercharged technology meta, and platform usage metrics (`https://nms-optimizer.app/userstats/`).
- [Community Localization & Translation Guide](https://nms-optimizer.app/translation/index.md): Guide for contributing translations and localizing the optimizer for global No Man's Sky communities (`https://nms-optimizer.app/translation/`).
- [Privacy Policy](https://nms-optimizer.app/privacy/index.md): Information regarding local storage usage and anonymous telemetry (`https://nms-optimizer.app/privacy/`).
